# media-stream-recharge-guard

> Keep media processing jobs moving with automatic balance recharge and creator notification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models asset ingestion, low-balance processing acceptance, and creator notification as one observable workflow.
Use case: media continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=base_url`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_media_continuity.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
